Now I see the issue. In `proc_plaintext` at line 949, `free_packet(pkt, NULL)` is called. But `pkt` is the same `pkt` from the outer loop in `do_proc_packets`. After `proc_plaintext` returns, the loop continues and at the bottom, it checks `newpkt` and eventually calls `free_packet(pkt, &parsectx)` at the top of the next iteration (line 1536). But wait, `free_packet(pkt, NULL)` in `proc_plaintext` frees the packet contents and sets `pkt->pkt.generic = NULL`. Then when `parse_packet` is called again, it allocates new data.
